3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:3b09ac8e-cf37.title: Occupational Therapy Consultant
3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:3b09ac8e-cf37.description: Why This Role Exists We’re expanding our Occupational Therapy services and need Occupational Therapists (OTs) to serve as part‑time consultants. You will help us shape local care models, expand insurance contracts, and if interested, create a launch‑pad to build or grow your own independent practice—without the usual operational headache. Key Responsibilities - We are looking for a variable commitment, up to 1 hr commitment per week - Advise on state regulations, cultural nuances, and care‑model innovation. - Advise on policies and outcome metrics to ensure evidence‑based, family‑centered care. - Act as the primary credentialed provider for the group when we are applying to commercial and Medicaid plans in your state. - Use and critique our all‑in‑one tech stack (scheduling, data, EHR, billing) to guide product improvements. - If you wish, start seeing clients on our platform and build your own practice over time (no upfront fees, full ops support). What We Provide - World‑class operational support so you stay focused on clinical input. - Fully integrated practice‑management suite, payer enrollment team, and rapid‑pay billing. - Access to a nationwide peer community - Priority eligibility for a full practice‑owner track with 3Y Health whenever you’re ready. Ideal Candidate - Active OT license in good standing in Texas - License to practice in multiple states a plus - Familiarity with payer credentialing or utilization‑management processes is a plus. - Passion for expanding equitable occupational therapy care and experimenting with outcome‑driven models. - Enjoys autonomy and remote, flexible collaboration Compensation Compensation will be $100-150 per hour dependent on experience and geographic location. About 3Y Health At 3Y Health, we believe OTs deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where OTs can launch and grow your own practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. For more information, please visit: https://3yhealth.com/specialties/occupational-therapy What Makes 3Y Health Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. What We Provide Practice Owners: - All-in-one software suite – Includes Practice Management, Scheduling, EHR, Data Collection, Billing, Onboarding, and mobile apps for you and your clients. - Insurance partnerships – We’re adding new payer partnerships all the time in multiple states - Practice launch support – We’ll help you start your own OT-focused company if you don’t already have one. - Fast payments – Get paid upfront per session. No more chasing down insurance. - Payroll made easy – We’ll run payroll for you if you’d like.

You will shape how we attract, reward, and retain top talent, while building infrastructure that scales with the business. distro-distro:lever:775f4adc-f6fe-4bcb-a.description: Job Summary The Traffic Control Coordinator ensures the safe and efficient movement of vehicles and pedestrians during construction or special events. Responsibilities include developing and implementing traffic control plans that comply with local regulations and safety standards. The coordinator collaborates with law enforcement, construction teams, and event organizers to reduce disruptions and enhance public safety. Monitoring traffic flow and adjusting control measures aim to reduce congestion and prevent accidents, maintaining order and safety in busy urban environments. Essential Duties and Responsibilities • Develop and implement comprehensive traffic control plans for construction sites and special events. • Coordinate with local authorities, law enforcement, and construction teams to ensure compliance with traffic regulations. • Monitor traffic flow and adjust control measures in real-time to minimize congestion and enhance safety. • Conduct site assessments to identify potential traffic hazards and recommend appropriate solutions. • Prepare reports and documentation related to traffic control measures and incidents. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities • Strong analytical skills to assess traffic patterns and identify potential issues. • Effective communication skills for coordination with law enforcement and construction teams. • Attention to detail to ensure compliance with safety standards when developing traffic control plans. • Preferred: Knowledge of traffic laws and regulations to support informed decision-making. Education & Experience • High school diploma or equivalent. • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record. • Experience in traffic management or a related field. • Certification in traffic control or traffic management. • Experience working with local government agencies or construction companies. #SolvoHRGlobal #LI-PROMOTED #LI-Onsite

jobgether-jobgether:lever:163335ff-a755-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner based in Saudi Arabia. This is a fully remote Product Owner role focused on connecting client needs, business objectives, and technical execution. You will own the product lifecycle from discovery and roadmap definition through continuous iteration and improvement. A major part of the role involves building trusted client relationships from initial conversations through long-term partnerships. You’ll translate business requirements into clear product direction while collaborating closely with developers and AI-assisted tools. The position combines product strategy, stakeholder management, consultative communication, and account growth. You’ll work within a highly distributed international environment alongside professionals across multiple countries and time zones. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership while enjoying significant flexibility over where and how you work. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end, including discovery, product strategy, roadmap definition, prioritization, delivery, and iteration based on client, user, and market feedback. Lead client interactions from initial discussions and onboarding through ongoing account management, building relationships that support long-term partnerships. Translate client needs, business objectives, and user feedback into clear product requirements and actionable priorities for development teams. Collaborate with engineers and AI-assisted tools to define solutions, clarify requirements, and support effective product delivery. Build prototypes and contribute to product strategy, helping stakeholders visualize solutions and align around product direction. Communicate product value in a consultative manner by educating and advising clients rather than relying on a transactional sales approach. Proactively engage existing accounts to identify issues early, manage expectations, gather feedback, and uncover opportunities for renewal and expansion. Develop strong, trusted relationships that contribute to retention, account growth, and referrals. Collect, evaluate, and prioritize feedback from clients, users, internal stakeholders, and market signals to continuously improve the product roadmap. Bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring product priorities and business objectives remain aligned throughout the development process. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with demonstrated experience defining roadmaps, managing backlogs, prioritizing features, and working with development teams. Proven experience in a client-facing role involving business development, sales, account management, or consultative relationship building. Demonstrated ability to retain and grow customer accounts over time, rather than focusing solely on new business acquisition. Strong client relationship-building skills and a consultative, customer-first approach. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex product concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Native or near-native proficiency in spoken and written English. Experience building prototypes and translating early-stage ideas into actionable product strategies and requirements. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and incorporating emerging technologies into product development workflows. Ability to work independently and effectively within a fully distributed, international team across multiple time zones. Strong organizational skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to balance competing priorities. A proactive, relationship-oriented mindset with a strong focus on long-term customer success. Nice to have: Previous sales experience, particularly in a consultative environment. Nice to have: Experience working directly with clients in the United States. Benefits:

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6d4352e1-2e83-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. Part calendar guru, part host, part quiet fixer of whatever's about to go sideways, you make sure hiring never becomes the bottleneck. strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:78223.title: Internal Quality Control Technician
strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:78223.description: Job Opportunity: Internal Quality Control Technician with Fameccanica in West Chester, OH Take charge of product quality—your commitment ensures excellence from the start. If you’re passionate about spotting problems early, maintaining high standards, and safeguarding product integrity, this position is ideal for you. As an IQC Technician at Fameccanica, your responsibility is to make sure only top-quality, compliant components are used in production. You act as the primary guardian of quality and work closely with teams throughout Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Supplier Quality. Why this role matters: You stop problems before they start by preventing defects from reaching production. Your judgment matters — this is risk‑based inspection, not checkbox work. Your findings directly support supplier performance and corrective actions. You see the full quality picture, from incoming materials to traceability. What You’ll Do: Inspect incoming parts using visual checks and precision tools. Verify supplier documentation including CoCs, material certs, and FAI/CMM data. Identify nonconforming material, create NCRs, and ensure containment. Apply risk‑based sampling based on part criticality and supplier performance. Collaborate cross‑functionally to resolve issues and improve processes. This role is a great fit if you: Are detail‑oriented but understand the bigger picture. Value accuracy, documentation, and consistency. Enjoy hands‑on work with real impact on production and customers. What you bring: 2+ years in quality inspection or manufacturing. Experience using precision measurement tools. Ability to read engineering drawings and understand GD&T basics. Experience with nonconformance reporting and quality systems. Supplier quality or outsourced manufacturing experience. Knowledge of ISO 9001, AS9100, or similar systems. FAI, CMM, ERP/MRP, or QMS experience. Additional details: Manufacturing and warehouse environment. Standing for extended periods; occasional lifting up to 40 lbs. Up to 10% travel may be required. Why Fameccanica: Quality at Fameccanica is built in, not inspected in at the end. You will join a team that values precision, accountability, and continuous improvement — and your work will be visible, respected, and meaningful. Apply online today! #HP

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:979f2dde-2fb.title: Spanish Accessibility Tester
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:979f2dde-2fb.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. About the Role Welocalize is expanding its network of accessibility testers to validate the language-specific accessibility of localized digital content: web pages, applications, and documents. You will serve as a native-language expert reviewer, confirming that accessibility elements not only survive translation but are accurate, understandable, and functional in Spanish. This role requires fluency in the target language, hands-on experience with assistive technology in that language, and familiarity with Digital Accessibility standards and guidelines such as PDF/UA, WCAG 2.1 & 2.2, and EN 301 549 to complement accessibility testing done internally. Work is assigned on a project basis. You will receive a defined scope, a testing checklist, and access credentials. Findings are reported in a structured defect log and specific bug tracking system. What You Will Do The actual scope will vary by assignment, but the general extent of this role is outlined below. Language Validation: Confirm correct language codes in HTML and PDF metadata, and identify mixed-language content missing proper declarations. In-Language Screen Reader Testing: Using native-language screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, or Narrator), review translated accessible text — including hidden elements, tooltips, error messages, alt text, and UI labels — for accuracy, natural phrasing, and clarity when read aloud. Multimedia Accessibility Review: Evaluate captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions for accuracy, synchronization, and natural language, and confirm multimedia controls are properly labeled in the target language. Defect Reporting: Log findings with WCAG/PDF-UA references, supporting screenshots or recordings, and severity classifications; participate in review calls with the QA Lead as needed. What We Are Looking For Required Native or near-native fluency in Spanish; you are the authoritative voice on whether translated content reads naturally and is understandable. Demonstrated hands-on experience testing digital content with assistive technology/AT. Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 AA and EN 301 549. Ability to evaluate content from a native-speaker accessibility perspective — not just technical compliance, but real-world usability for screen reader users who speak the language. Reliable access to relevant devices and operating systems to replicate real-world usage in the target locale. Nice to have Strong written communication skills in English for defect reporting and general communications. Experience with PDF accessibility testing using PAC 3 or Adobe Acrobat Pro Accessibility Checker. Familiarity with internationalization, localization, and translation workflows; understanding of how accessibility elements can be affected during format conversion. Personal use of assistive technology. Tools and Environment Welocalize provides access credentials and a structured test plan per engagement. Testers are expected to supply their own device and assistive technology setup appropriate to the target locale. Commonly used tools in this role include: Screen readers: JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), TalkBack (Android), Narrator (Windows) Browser/screen reader pairings aligned to the target locale's most common usage patterns Caption and transcript review: native video players, .srt/.vtt file review PDF accessibility: PAC 3, Adobe Acrobat Pro (provided where required) Defect logging: Jira bug tracking system is most frequently used What to Expect Assignments are project-based with clear scope documents, test checklists, and agreed turnaround timelines provided before work beg
